protocol.seed_note: held-out: evaluation seeds are 9,000,000+; tuning and training seeds are below 1,000,000
protocol.paired: all managers run on the same seeds (common random numbers)
protocol.scores: score_<objective> = mean hourly reward under that objective's weights on baseline-normalised terms (higher is better); constrained objective: -cost_term - 5*relu(p95_wait/threshold - 1)
